# R6-pixel frozen tables (generated by gen/r6gen.py; the .txt tables and .tsv predictions are the frozen files)

Sets: control, heldout, replicate, table.  Stage order: p6-rd, p6-l3, g6-rwa, g6-rw, p6-s.  Quantity = value [hypothesis].

## p6-rd

Q276 (pixel), stage p6-rd: is an o4..o7 write stored (readable back in the instance), and does the predicate gate it.  R5's
command and word layout; each rd-j program is the walk row w-j with `mov.skipinv r10, oJ; mov.skipinv.end o0, r10` last, so the
own pixel shows what oJ held (E373).  TRI = own pixels of c-rd-0 in both jobs.  Models over rd-1..rd-7: H-STORE (S everywhere),
H-FOUR (S at 1..3, not S at 4..7), H-O0 (A0 everywhere), H-MOD4 (S at 1..3, o_(j-4)'s word at 4..7).  Controls first: c-e709
(G-o4), c-u (G-o1), c-all4 (5:1), c-ow, c-rd-0 (readback through r10), c-prd-0 k1/k7 (gates prd).  Bridge (the driver's gate):
c-e709, c-u, c-ow, c-rd-0.  No fault is expected; any fault, hang or STATUS2 other than 0x400 after a reset stops the stage.

Pseudo-cases (read by the scorer):

- @p6-rd: premise = o4..o7's own words reach no pixel of any kept image (0 of 12143 words of w-4..w-7, no tag-8 word in E570); E081's o4..o7 counts are leftovers (heldout); models = H-STORE=S,S,S,S,S,S,S H-FOUR=S,S,S,!S,!S,!S,!S H-O0=A0,A0,A0,A0,A0,A0,A0 H-MOD4=S,S,S,A0,A4,A4,A4 (heldout); class_rule = one class at >= 0.9 of the TRI pixels of both jobs; X: < 0.05 carry the job's marker; O: >= 0.9 one other marker; else cannot tell (heldout); lane_rule = a lane reads a label with >= 0.95 of its TRI pixels in both jobs (heldout); prd_gate = prd-j scored only if rd-j reads S and both c-prd-0 rows pass; else cannot tell by design (heldout); verdict = the predicate gates the o_j write iff gated at k = 0, 1, 2, 3 and 7 (heldout)

Row roles:

- c-e709-x: G-o4 control: E709's o4g-3 unchanged (R4, R5)
- c-e709-y: G-o4 control: E709's o4g-3 unchanged (R4, R5)
- c-u-x: G-o1 control: R4's own c-u program byte for byte

- c-all4-x: R5's c-all4 program byte for byte: every output with bit 4, read 5:1 (E858)

- c-ow-x: c-ow: o0 = tag 1 bits 2, then o0 = tag 1 bits 1 (.end): the last o0 write is the pixel
- c-ow-y: c-ow: o0 = tag 1 bits 2, then o0 = tag 1 bits 1 (.end): the last o0 write is the pixel (the y job)
- c-rd-0-x: c-rd-0: o0 = W_A (bits 2); mov r10, o0; o0 = W_B (bits 3); mov.end o0, r10: W_A read back (E373)

- c-prd-0-k1-x: c-prd-0 k = 1: o0 = W_0 (bits 2), p1 = (g25 == 1), p1 o0 = W_1 (bits 1), o7 .end
- c-prd-0-k1-y: c-prd-0 k = 1: o0 = W_0 (bits 2), p1 = (g25 == 1), p1 o0 = W_1 (bits 1), o7 .end (the y job)
- c-prd-0-k7-x: c-prd-0 k = 7: o0 = W_0 (bits 2), p1 = (g25 == 7), p1 o0 = W_1 (bits 1), o7 .end
- c-prd-0-k7-y: c-prd-0 k = 7: o0 = W_0 (bits 2), p1 = (g25 == 7), p1 o0 = W_1 (bits 1), o7 .end (the y job)
- rd-1-x: readback rd-1: the walk row w-1 (o1 bit 4, the rest bit 5), then mov r10, o1; mov.end o0, r10
